comment: How much a site the group uses draws attention: noise, light, smoke and smell build up while people stay and fade after they leave. Units are arbitrary 'attention points'. Signals are per hour while they last; one-off noises add their weight scaled by how close they were (1 - distance/radius).
comment_arrival: A group carrying its loads through the streets and forcing its way into a building is seen and heard: a new base starts with this much attention.
comment_attacks: Night attacks need the infected to know the group is there: chance scales with attack_baseline + attention / attack_reference, so an unknown new site sees about a third of the attacks of a site that has drawn 100 points.
